articles.title: Max Financial Services reports massive profit growth of Rs 100 crore in Q2 FY26
articles.desc: Max Financial Services recorded a substantial rise in net profit during the second quarter to ₹100 crore. This marks a significant increase from ₹5.9 crore in the same period last year. The company owns an 80% stake in Axis Max Life, contributing to its financial growth. Additionally, its value of new business rose 21% year-on-year, reaching ₹1,180 crore in H1 FY27.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks advance on resurgent AI optimism
articles.desc: The MSCI Asia Pacific Index rose 0.6%, as benchmarks in Australia, Japan and South Korea advanced. The Kospi Index rose 2.6%, with SK Hynix Inc.’s stock climbing after the company reported operating profit that beat estimates. The chipmaker is planning a total of 100 trillion won ($75.4 billion) in shareholder returns for 2026.

articles.title: Credit growth to moderate in H2, FY27: Icra
articles.desc: Credit growth is projected to ease to 15-16% for FY27, impacted by hardening policy rates. Fresh slippages for public sector banks are estimated to increase to ₹1 lakh crore in FY27. Private banks may experience fresh slippages amounting to ₹1.3 lakh crore. While banks' asset quality may deteriorate slightly, net interest margins should improve. The overall banking sector faces challenges amid these credit growth expectations and market conditions.

articles.desc: Indian benchmark indices saw a volatile session amid the Nifty and Bank Nifty monthly expiry. Stocks like Jio Platforms made headlines following its IPO debut after raising significant funds. Reliance Industries remained a focus as its financial results and fundraising plans were announced. Infosys successfully implemented a transformation project for Syngenta, enhancing operations and governance. Tata Capital reported a substantial profit increase, driven by loan growth and higher interest income.

articles.title: Cipla’s US recovery, biosimilar pipeline key to future growth prospects
articles.desc: Cipla's September-quarter earnings suffered due to a high base in its US business. The company reported sequential growth driven by its strong India business and branded prescription therapies. Recent approvals for respiratory products and a growing biosimilar pipeline bolster Cipla's optimism for future growth. Despite declining operating margins, the firm anticipates improvements supported by product launches. Cipla remains focused on evaluating inorganic opportunities to enhance its specialty portfolio.

This change occurred despite rising oil prices and foreign fund outflows from the market. The Reserve Bank of India is believed to have intervened by selling dollars to stabilize the currency. Traders noted that the prices fluctuated and remained capped near the 95.25 resistance level.

articles.desc: US stocks saw gains as renewed optimism about artificial intelligence lifted chipmakers while corporate earnings were evaluated. Although concerns about AI spending persist, news of Anthropic's IPO provided a relief rally for the sector. The Federal Reserve began its policy meeting, with expectations for interest rates to remain unchanged. Nearly half of S&P 500 companies reported earnings, with many exceeding estimates while some major firms faced declines.

articles.desc: NYSE is preparing to launch binary return options that will let investors make all-or-nothing bets on whether stocks and ETFs finish above or below set prices. The exchange is also seeking approval for KPI options linked to company earnings metrics, expanding the range of event-driven trading products available to investors.

articles.title: India in striking distance of 8% growth as reforms boost economy: Shaktikanta Das
articles.desc: Das said the BFSI sector has a crucial role to play in India's journey from a lower-middle-income economy to a high-income economy, through its intermediation in allocation of financial resources. He said the sector would be required to support India's next-gen Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), be the frontline of green and transition finance and become the catalyst for democratising financial inclusion to support this journey.

articles.title: Credit card additions hit second-highest monthly level in 2026 as banks gear up for festive season
articles.desc: HDFC Bank and Axis Bank together accounted for nearly 43% of the net additions during September, adding 539,878 cards between them. The two private sector lenders emerged as the largest contributors to fresh additions, followed by SBI Cards.

articles.title: Boeing cuts delivery target, shares hit 18-month low as recovery takes longer
articles.desc: Boeing has announced a cut in its 737 Max delivery target for this year, which raises concerns. The company now aims to increase 737 production to 52 jets per month in the second half of next year. Boeing reported a wider than expected loss in its commercial airplane division but posted positive free cash flow results. Despite delays, the company plans to begin deliveries of its 777-9 jets next year.

articles.title: GST registration gets easier as CBIC drops Udyam proof, sets seven-day limit for approvals
articles.desc: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs has issued clarifications regarding GST registration requirements for businesses. Companies will no longer need to provide Udyam certificates or face rejections due to unpaid bills. Registration applications must be processed within seven working days with Aadhaar authentication. Tax demands must include clear justifications and cannot be arbitrary. These changes aim to simplify compliance and reduce disputes in tax administration.

articles.title: Centre eases GST rules for post-sales discounts, no prior agreement needed from November 1
articles.desc: The Centre eases GST rules on post-sales discounts from November 1, no longer requiring a prior agreement, which is expected to help FMCG and pharma companies and retailers.

articles.title: India to emerge as major exporter to China, ASEAN, get edge in US trade pact, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal highlighted India's potential to expand exports to China and ASEAN. Negotiations are underway for a trade pact with the United States that could provide India a comparative advantage. The country is also working towards an Investment Protection Agreement with the European Union. Goyal indicated that discussions for preferential trade agreements are progressing with multiple countries and groups.

articles.title: Government mulls simplifying application process under Press Note 2 to ease FDI flow from border nations: Sources
articles.desc: The government had relaxed FDI restrictions imposed under Press Note 3 for countries sharing land borders with India, such as China and Pakistan, through Press Note 2 in March.

articles.title: Prediction market Kalshi expands safeguards for young traders
articles.desc: Kalshi is tightening safeguards for traders aged 18 to 20, introducing a $2,500 monthly deposit limit and alerts for users who put a large share of their funds into one trade. The prediction market also announced partnerships with youth safety groups as scrutiny over gambling risks grows

articles.title: GM to transfer stock listing to Nasdaq
articles.desc: General Motors made an announcement on Tuesday that they’re moving their common stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange over to Nasdaq. This change is part of their strategy to better position themselves in the market. Investors and analysts are keeping a close eye on how this move will affect GM's stock performance and reputation.

articles.title: Trading starts on LME's first contract from Shanghai exchange collaboration
articles.desc: The London Metal Exchange's new hot-rolled coil steel contract began trading on Tuesday, marking the first product from its collaboration with the Shanghai Futures Exchange. More than 550 lots traded in the first two active months, while two 2027 contracts were held back over a potential technical issue.

articles.title: India's growth momentum stays resilient despite global headwinds: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta
articles.desc: Reserve Bank Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta indicated that India's real GDP growth fell short due to external shocks. She highlighted that India has managed over 7 percent growth despite challenging circumstances in recent years. Additionally, Gupta expressed confidence that improved global conditions could enhance growth by another percentage point. She discussed the importance of diversifying economic activities to mitigate risks and emphasized that food security remains stable amid El Nino.

articles.title: Allied Blenders Q2 Results: Profit rises 9.7% to Rs 69 crore, revenue up 6.8%
articles.desc: Allied Blenders and Distillers reported a net profit increase of 9.7% in the September quarter of FY27. The company's revenue from operations rose by 6.8% compared to the previous fiscal year. Total expenses for the quarter were recorded at Rs 1,946.3 crore, reflecting a 6.51% rise. Total income, including other income, increased by 6.74% at Rs 2,089.46 crore in Q2 FY27. The shares of ABD closed at Rs 692.

articles.title: Indus Towers Q2 Results: Net profit slips 2.5% to Rs 1,793 crore
articles.desc: Indus Towers reported a 2.5% decline in consolidated net profit for the second quarter ended September 30. The company experienced a 4% increase in consolidated revenue, while EBITDA saw a slight rise of 0.4%. Tower and co-location bases grew by 5.6% and 5.9%, respectively, contributing to improved performance. Strong customer demand and cash generation were highlighted as key growth drivers.

articles.desc: Steel Authority of India Ltd announced a significant increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The company reported a profit of Rs 1,750.47 crore, a substantial rise from the previous year. Revenue from operations also saw growth, reaching Rs 31,997.55 crore compared to Rs 26,704.17 crore last year. Total expenses rose modestly to Rs 29,913.65 crore from Rs 26,113.64 crore.

articles.title: United Breweries Q2 Results: Profit jumps nearly 3 times to Rs 134 crore on volume growth, premiumisation
articles.desc: United Breweries Ltd experienced a nearly three-fold increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations rose by 23.7 percent year-on-year, reflecting strong market performance. Premium volumes notably surged, particularly for Heineken Silver and Kingfisher Ultra, enhancing UBL's premium offerings. Total expenses also increased, but operating efficiency and cost control contributed to profitability expansion. UBL remains optimistic about future growth opportunities in the Indian beer market.

articles.title: Russia’s farm exports to India rise 11% in nine months, led by sunflower oil
articles.desc: Russia's agricultural exports to India rose significantly in the first nine months of the year. Agroexport reported shipments reached 1.3 million tons, primarily driven by sunflower oil. This represents an 11% increase in volume compared to previous figures, amounting to $1.45 billion. Trade between India and Russia has expanded significantly, growing more than 20% overall this year. Both countries aim for $100 billion in bilateral trade by 2030.

articles.title: SBI Life Insurance Q2 Results: Net profit grows 11% YoY to Rs 549 crore
articles.desc: SBI Life Insurance recorded an 11 percent increase in net profit for the second quarter. The net profit reached Rs 549 crore compared to Rs 495 crore last year. Additionally, the company’s net premium income grew by 8.17 percent to Rs 26,877 crore. This increase in profit and income highlights the company’s strong financial performance in the current fiscal year. Shares of SBI Life closed at Rs 1,634.

articles.title: Tata Capital Q2 net profit rises 51% on higher income
articles.desc: Tata Capital’s second-quarter net profit rose 51% year-on-year to Rs 1,660 crore, supported by higher interest income and loan growth. Assets under management increased 26% to Rs 3.08 lakh crore, while floating-rate lending adjustments and margin improvement remain key priorities.

articles.title: Waaree Energies Q2 Results: Profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 719 crore, revenue rises 24%
articles.desc: Waaree Energies reported a 14.7% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 718.68 crore in Q2FY27, despite 23.9% revenue growth. Margin pressure persisted as the company acquired data centre subsidiaries, exploring diversification into AI and digital infrastructure.

articles.desc: Policymakers at the US Federal Reserve opened a two-day meeting Tuesday to set interest rates, with markets expecting them to hold steady days ahead of crucial midterm elections. articles.desc: Reliance Industries will announce its September-quarter results on October 30, alongside considering fundraising through non-convertible debentures. Investors will track performance across O2C, telecom, retail and energy businesses amid share price weakness and market uncertainty.

articles.title: Global bond issuance set to grow at slowest pace in five years in 2027, S&P Global Ratings says
articles.desc: In 2027, global bond issuance is expected to rise by a mere 2.7%, marking a stark decline compared to this year's growth. According to S&P Global Ratings, factors like increasing interest rates and geopolitical tensions contribute to this slowdown. Additionally, with both governments and firms facing heightened funding needs, borrowing appetites may wane.

articles.title: JetBlue shares surge 12% as airline seeks to calm financial concerns
articles.desc: JetBlue Airways shares surged over 12% after addressing financial concerns despite reporting a larger quarterly loss. The loss was influenced by soaring fuel prices resulting from the ongoing war in Iran. JetBlue ended the third quarter with significant liquidity and assets, which provided some stability. However, rising fuel costs continue to exert pressure on the airline's margins and profitability.

articles.title: India considers measures to boost local production of 100 critical inputs to cut import reliance, government official says
articles.desc: India is taking steps to encourage the local manufacturing of 100 key items that are currently imported. This initiative aims to decrease dependence on foreign suppliers, especially from China, to enhance domestic production capabilities. The government has identified these crucial items from a broader import list valued at $51 billion, which includes various sectors. By reducing reliance on imports, India hopes to strengthen its economy and mitigate supply chain risks.

articles.title: US stocks today: S&P 500, Nasdaq advance as oil eases ahead of Fed decision
articles.desc: US stocks are experiencing an uptick with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq gaining due to easing oil prices. The Federal Reserve is expected to maintain rates steady in its upcoming decision after last month's hike. Investors are keenly anticipating earnings results from major technology firms, which will provide insights into AI investments. Boeing and Xylem faced losses, while Royal Caribbean and General Motors reported positive forecasts.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO rocks Indian IT; Why Walmart is in no hurry to list Flipkart
articles.desc: Anthropic’s US IPO filing sent Indian IT stocks lower on Tuesday. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

articles.title: PVR Inox among stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 20% in a month
articles.desc: Six BSE 500 stocks hit fresh 52-week highs despite the Sensex closing nearly flat. International Gemological Institute led monthly gains at 19%, followed by PVR Inox, Acutaas Chemicals, Indian Hotels, Laurus Labs and Sona BLW.

articles.title: JSW Infrastructure Q2 Results: Net profit falls 11% to Rs 328 crore
articles.desc: JSW Infrastructure reported an 11 percent drop in consolidated net profit for the September quarter, with earnings falling to Rs 328.23 crore from Rs 368.81 crore the previous year. The company achieved total income of Rs 1,669.47 crore, while expenses rose to Rs 1,238.34 crore. Notably, cargo volumes from India operations grew by 8 percent year-on-year, reaching 29.4 million tonnes.

articles.title: Sebi extends deadline for debenture trustees to comply with norms till April 2027
articles.desc: Sebi has extended the deadline for debenture trustees to comply with regulatory requirements by six months. The new deadline for compliance is now set for April 27, 2027. This extension was granted after receiving industry feedback about operational challenges faced by debenture trustees. The regulator is currently reviewing the regulatory framework related to debenture trustees through an Expert Working Group.

articles.title: Coca-Cola raises profit forecast as premium drinks, sodas hold strong
articles.desc: Coca-Cola has lifted its annual profit forecast, driven by robust demand for a range of beverages, particularly zero-sugar options. The company now anticipates earnings per share growth of at least 9% by 2026. Their third-quarter revenue soared to $13.38 billion, exceeding analysts' expectations, while Coca-Cola's strong showing stands in sharp contrast to PepsiCo's recent downgrades and cost-cutting plans. Following these promising results, Coca-Cola shares rose nearly 1% in premarket trading.

articles.title: Market wrap: Bharti Airtel, Tata Consumer, Asian Paints, Coal India top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
articles.desc: Indian equity benchmarks ended nearly flat on Tuesday, with the Nifty 50 slipping 0.02% and the Sensex falling 8 points amid elevated crude prices and caution ahead of the US Fed decision. Tata Consumer and Bharti Airtel led gainers, while Asian Paints and Coal India topped the losers’ list.

articles.title: Tata Capital Q2 Results: Profit jumps 51% to Rs 1,660 crore; NII up 23%
articles.desc: Tata Capital’s September-quarter net profit surged 51% year-on-year to Rs 1,660 crore, driven by loan growth, higher interest income and lower provisions. Its loan book crossed Rs 3 lakh crore, while improving margins and asset quality strengthened profitability.

articles.title: India benchmark yield falls most in 3 months on value buying
articles.desc: Indian government bonds are witnessing a resurgence despite previous instability, as the benchmark 10-year yield has notably decreased. Brent crude prices varied between $114.40 and $117 a barrel during Asian trading. These fluctuations within the debt market have uplifted investor sentiments, and the Indian rupee appears to be stabilizing, contributing positively.

articles.title: Vedanta Iron Q2 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 324 crore, revenue declines 2% YoY
articles.desc: Vedanta Iron and Steel narrowed its Q2 FY27 loss to Rs 324 crore from Rs 477 crore a year earlier, while revenue declined 1.7% to Rs 2,742 crore. EBITDA rose 56% to Rs 83 crore, supported by improved steel realisations and efficiency gains. The company also reported record half-yearly pig iron production.

articles.title: US Stock Market Live Updates: US stocks end higher as AI rally lifts Nasdaq ahead of Fed decision
Larsen & Toubro Q2 Results: Profit surges 33% YoY to Rs 5,202 crore, revenue grows 16%
articles.desc: L&T Q2 Results: Larsen & Toubro announced significant financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a 33% increase in consolidated profit after tax compared to the previous year. Consolidated revenue also grew by 16%, driven by strong performance across various sectors. Additionally, L&T achieved its highest quarterly order inflow and saw substantial international participation in its orders.

articles.title: Raymond Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 130% YoY to Rs 32 crore, revenue rises 24%
articles.desc: Raymond reported a 130% year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 32 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue rose 24.1% to Rs 655 crore. EBITDA increased 74.4% to Rs 75 crore, with margins expanding 336 basis points to 11.5%. The company has also proposed a name change to Raymond Aerospace, Defence & Engineering.

articles.title: Greece raises €500 million from three-month T-bills, yield rises
articles.desc: Greece has successfully sold €500 million worth of three-month Treasury bills. However, the yield on these bills was higher than what they offered in the last auction, indicating a shift in the market. This move comes as the country's debt agency reiterated its ongoing efforts to manage its financial obligations amidst fluctuating economic conditions.

articles.title: Britain issues costliest 5-year debt since 2008 before budget
articles.desc: Britain conducted a sale of £4.5 billion worth of 5-year debt at a yield of 5.036%. This yield reflects the highest rate seen since the year 2008, indicating market pressures on the government. Investors showed robust interest, bidding 3.51 times the amount available during the gilt auction. Experts anticipate only a modest rise in debt issuance as projected figures indicate increased financing requirements.

articles.title: We will see India becoming major exporter of goods and services to China: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal emphasised India's willingness to engage with Chinese suppliers. He highlighted the importance of fair play and judicial processes regarding pricing discrepancies. India aims to enhance exports to China and the ASEAN region over the coming years. Recent trade data shows a significant increase in India-China bilateral trade. The Indian government is also addressing concerns related to China's export controls on key machinery.

articles.title: UPI-MDR an additional earnings opportunity, not Paytm's business model foundation: Brokerages
articles.desc: Paytm has reported a substantial increase in revenue, demonstrating the success of its existing business model. The company's EBITDA has improved due to efficient cost control and a strong merchant franchise. Financial services have significantly contributed to revenue growth, highlighting the diversity of its business operations. Global brokerages support the view that UPI-MDR will enhance, rather than define, future profitability.

articles.title: PayPal raises 2026 profit forecast as turnaround gains traction
articles.desc: PayPal has raised its annual profit forecast as a multi-year turnaround begins to take effect. The company anticipates achieving significant cost savings through workforce reductions and operational efficiencies. Consumer spending remains strong despite economic challenges, aiding growth in payment volume. Additionally, PayPal expects adjusted profits in the upcoming holiday quarter to exceed Wall Street expectations. The focus on transformation under new leadership aims for sustainable profitability.

articles.title: IMF to India: Let the Rupee Be Your First Line of Defence | Krishna Srinivasan
WeWork India H1FY27 net profit rockets 150%, revenue surges 30%
articles.desc: WeWork India’s first-half FY27 net profit surged 149.5% to Rs 119 crore, while revenue grew 30.1% to Rs 1,466.7 crore. Capacity expansion, rising memberships, stronger cash flows and improved margins supported growth and strengthened its financial position.

articles.title: Bitcoin trades near $79,000 as Fed rate uncertainty, selling pressure weigh on crypto markets
articles.desc: Bitcoin slipped near $79,000 as investors awaited the Federal Reserve’s policy decision. ETF outflows, macroeconomic uncertainty and selling pressure weakened sentiment, while traders monitored $78,000 support, inflation data and institutional demand for potential market direction.

articles.title: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders shares crash 10% after Q2 net profit tumbles 54%; firm declares Rs 5/share dividend
articles.desc: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders shares plunged 10% after the state-owned company reported a 54% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 344 crore. Revenue from operations fell 16.5% to Rs 2,446 crore, while margins contracted sharply. The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share.

articles.title: WeWork India H1 net profit rises 150%, revenue up 30.1%
articles.desc: WeWork India reported a 149.5% year-on-year rise in first-half FY27 net profit to Rs 119 crore, while revenue grew 30.1% to Rs 1,466.7 crore. Capacity expansion, membership growth and improved operating margins supported performance. Operating cash flow strengthened, and the company shifted to a net cash position amid rising demand for flexible workspaces.

articles.title: 10 microcap stocks rally up to 80% in just 3 months
articles.desc: Despite a roughly 4% decline in the Nifty 50 and Nifty Microcap 250 over three months, 40 Nifty Microcap 250 stocks posted double-digit gains. PC Jeweller led the top 10 outperformers, with its share price surging 78%, followed by Sigma Advanced Systems at 57%.

articles.title: Global Market: European shares fall as HSBC earnings drag banking stocks
articles.desc: European shares fell as HSBC's disappointing revenue weighed on banking stocks, while political unrest in France dampened investor sentiment. The STOXX 600 slipped, with gains in healthcare stocks following Novartis' upgraded earnings outlook offering some support.

articles.title: UP Cabinet clears Rs 17,542-cr plan for four link expressways
articles.desc: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet has approved four link expressway projects that will span approximately 322 kilometers. These projects will be developed by the Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority under the EPC mode. The total cost for these projects amounts to Rs 17,542.06 crore and is to be fully borne by the state government. Completion of these expressways is expected within three years from the start of construction.

articles.title: FIIs M.I.A.(Missing in Action): IMF’s Krishna Srinivasan on how to Make India Attractive (M.I.A)
Big Tech earnings a test of the AI boom amid market turmoil
articles.desc: Investors are pressing for evidence that the AI boom can deliver swift returns to justify its enormous price tag. Rising bond yields at AI cloud providers such as CoreWeave and record costs to insure Meta Platform's debt have amplified concerns about how the massive AI infrastructure buildout is being funded, particularly as higher US interest rates loom.

articles.title: GST officers must prove intent to evade tax before invoking fraud provision: CBIC
articles.desc: GST officers cannot invoke fraud, wilful misstatement or suppression provisions merely because tax has not been paid or a discrepancy is found, the CBIC has clarified. Such provisions can be used only where there is specific evidence of deliberate intent to evade tax, and that evidence must be clearly set out in the show cause notice.

articles.title: US, Brazil and Israel elections put India’s trade worth billions in focus
articles.desc: Recent elections in the US, Brazil, and Israel may impact India's trade negotiations and economic partnerships. The US is close to finalizing a trade pact, which could affect Indian exports significantly. Brazil's growing economic relationship with India is leading to ambitious trade targets between the two nations. In Israel, the continuation of defense cooperation and negotiations for a free trade agreement are crucial for India.

articles.title: Uttar Pradesh turns to cattle to beef up rural incomes; ₹40,000 subsidy on offer per animal
articles.desc: Under UP State Livestock Mission, farmers buying eligible indigenous cows will receive a subsidy of Rs 40,000 per animal. The government will also pay 85% of the livestock insurance premium, leaving owners to bear the remaining 15%.

articles.title: RBI may raise repo rate to 6.25% by 2027 amid inflation risks: Deutsche Bank
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to raise the repo rate to 6.25% by mid-2027. This increase is driven by persistent inflationary pressures and robust economic growth expectations. Deutsche Bank forecasts an average consumer price index inflation of 6% in late 2026, stabilizing to 4.7% by FY28. India's GDP growth is projected above 7% for both FY27 and FY28.

articles.title: India to implement changes to GST from November 1
articles.desc: India plans to implement easing rules related to the goods and services tax for post-sale discounts while speeding up provisional refunds for businesses facing inverted duty structures from November 1, according to a government notification dated October 26.

articles.title: Resist temptation to defend ₹ at any cost: Raghuram Rajan cautions India against excessive use of forex reserves
articles.desc: Raghuram Rajan said India should avoid aggressively defending the rupee amid the current depreciation spree, stressing that a weaker rupee could only benefit India. The former RBI Governor cautioned against excessive use of foreign exchange reserves to maintain a specific exchange rate level.

articles.title: In China, the AI bubble has already burst
articles.desc: While global tech stocks teeter, in China they have already crashed as lofty valuations collapse under worries about AI demand and curbs on Chinese exports.

articles.title: Paytm has proven the resilience of its merchant-led model: JP Morgan
articles.desc: In its latest report titled "First Take: All-round beat", JP Morgan said Paytm's focus on its merchant franchise and sharp cost control following the resolution of regulatory restrictions has helped the company achieve EBIT breakeven, proving the resilience of its merchant-led model.

articles.title: Tata Motors, Amazon partner to deploy 3,000 electric trucks for ecommerce logistics
articles.desc: Heavy Industries Minister H D Kumaraswamy flagged off the initial fleet of trucks. "I congratulate Tata Motors and Amazon on this significant collaboration to deploy 3,000 electric trucks across Amazon's transportation network in India," Kumaraswamy said.

articles.title: West Asia crisis so far may cost govt Rs 1.35 lakh crore, spending cuts unlikely: ICRA Chief Economist Aditi Nayar
articles.desc: The West Asia crisis may impose a fiscal burden of approximately Rs 1.35 lakh crore on India. Government spending has generally remained below budget estimates, providing financial flexibility for these pressures. Higher customs duty collections from gold and silver imports might help offset some costs. ICRA anticipates GDP growth to remain robust, exceeding 7 percent in the second quarter of FY27.

articles.title: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming reclaims top spot in China's rich list, thanks to his firm's AI push
articles.desc: The rankings released by The Hurun Research Institute on Tuesday reflected that the country's high-tech sectors were rising but others like consumer and real estate were under pressure.

articles.title: Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
articles.desc: Figures obtained by BBC Newsnight show large spikes in sales of torches, radios and power banks.

articles.title: Alibaba AI model secretly tried to reach Beijing server in test, rival Cohere says
articles.desc: Canadian AI company Cohere said on Monday one of Alibaba's Qwen AI models tried to send data to an Alibaba Cloud storage server in Beijing during a security test. The model made the attempt even though its own reasoning indicated it would not do such a thing, Cohere said.

articles.title: Australia warns of 'unprecedented' AI threat
articles.desc: Artificial intelligence poses an "unprecedented" threat as foreign governments turn it loose to hack computer networks and critical infrastructure, Australia's cyber security agency warned on Tuesday. "This activity extends beyond government networks, and includes critical infrastructure entities, private businesses and individuals."

articles.title: Risks spelled out for Anthropic investors include possible harms from runaway AI
articles.desc: The risks laid out by the San Francisco company in its filing Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission included discussion of bad actors potentially using AI models to build deadly weapons or the technology itself going rogue with untold consequences.

articles.title: India-Russia trade grew by 20 per cent this year: Russian State Duma Chairman
articles.desc: India imported $44.9 billion of Russian goods during the period, including $36 billion in crude oil. Indian exports to Russia totaled $2.8 billion, with Moscow increasing purchases of chemicals, electrical goods, medical equipment, seafood, tea, and spices.

articles.title: Sugar season 2026–27 begins on schedule, nearly 107 mills commence operations across India: ISMA
articles.desc: In Maharashtra, the country’s largest sugar-producing state, close to 87 mills have commenced operations. More mills are expected to start in the coming week as cane harvesting gathers pace.

articles.title: India-US Trade Facilitation Portal records 3,500 registrations within months of launch: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Around 3,500 registrations have been recorded on the India-US Trade Facilitation Portal since its launch. This platform aims to connect Indian exporters with US-based buyers for improved trade relationships. It is particularly beneficial for micro, small and medium enterprises seeking market expansion.

articles.title: Wheat sowing lags at 11,000 hectare so far amid deficient monsoon; rabi acreage down
articles.desc: Wheat sowing in India has reached 11,000 hectares as of October 23, against 27,000 hectares a year earlier, as a deficient southwest monsoon raises concerns over soil moisture and irrigation availability. Punjab and Rajasthan face particular risks, while overall rabi crop coverage has also fallen, Agriculture Ministry data showed.

articles.title: Instagram tests 90-minute horizontal videos
articles.desc: On Monday, Instagram announced that it is testing out video lengths of up to 90 minutes with select creators in the US.

articles.title: RBI steps up liquidity support as tighter cash conditions push up borrowing rates: Report
articles.desc: Tightening liquidity in the banking system has pushed up short-term borrowing rates, prompting the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to inject funds into banks, according to an ICICI Bank report. Meanwhile, rising oil prices and concerns over inflation are putting pressure on government bond yields. The report expects the 10-year benchmark bond yield to trade between 7.40% and 7.60% in the near term.

articles.title: DoorDash in talks to buy Instacart in roughly $17 billion deal
articles.desc: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart in a deal that could value the grocery-delivery platform at about $17 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO by the numbers, from a possible valuation in the trillions to surging revenue
articles.desc: The artificial intelligence lab filed papers Monday setting up a Wall Street debut next month, ahead of its chief rival OpenAI and just months after SpaceX set records in June with an initial public offering that raised $86 billion.

articles.title: Why Walmart would rather keep Flipkart private, for now
articles.desc: Over the past few weeks, much has been written about former employees of the online commerce company writing to Walmart's board, asking for liquidity on the stock options they were granted 10 to 15 years ago. On October 1, at least eight former senior executives, among them former Myntra CEO Mukesh Bansal and former chief business officer Ankit Nagori, wrote to Walmart chairman Gregory Penner, other board members and Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, seeking a complete exit for all former employees holding vested options.

articles.title: VerSe valuation sinks; Paytm Q2 profit rises
articles.desc: Happy Tuesday! Dailyhunt parent VerSe Innovation’s valuation has taken a sharp hit. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.
